# Activity forms reference revision and makes it recur

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

The general laws of stock (Becoming.Stock) govern continuing revision: along every run of a balanced process, drawing at arbitrarily late steps needs replenishment at arbitrarily late steps, and unending repetition of a cycle needs its return to cover its draw. ContinuingRevision is an instance, extending ReferencePlan’s operations. Its fuel is balanced against what each act uses and what renewal returns (balanced); with the return cut, no unending run exists under any controller (no_run_without_return); along every run at every yield renewal recurs, renewal is enabled only by a successful undertaking at the next address, and so successful activity recurs (renew_recurs, renew_needs_enabled, enabled_by_success, success_recurs). With the fuel held in reserve and the yield as parameters, the cycle repeats for every number of rounds from some configuration exactly where the yield covers the nine units a round uses (repeats_iff), at every yield. In the witnesses at yield nine, actual failure, acquisition, installation and use form a reference apparatus from empty retention; mismatch at every successor revises the method and yields newly acquired, installed and successfully used references; an actual infinite Run obeys one controller and connects exactly to the formation trace, with cumulative amounts used and returned (continuing, formed_and_continues). Frozen methods, cut return, reserve expenditure and retired distinctions retain failures and losses.

Canonical source: [ContinuingRevision.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ContinuingRevision.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- P99’s addressed Boolean contacts, faithful return, bound references, stable correspondence, revision and checked-installation operations remain supplied.
- The supplied policy addresses the next locus; an actual success at the next address enables one renewal, used once. Renewal uses one unit and returns the yield (nine in the witnesses), retains the installed successor reference and retires the old contact.
- The counted installation is open to productive support. Physical contact/succession correspondence, replacement and storage are local premises; a finite closed stock is not claimed to continue forever.

Observation, method, response, production and carriers are roles in one unfolding. The carrier index accompanies new addressed activity, failure, reference construction and use; a counter alone does not prove material reconstruction. The clock enumerates actions already proved to follow choose, without external support or selection.
